description_en: Updates the status of an automated response rule
description_zh: 更新自动化响应规则状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem update-automate-response-config-status --ids 123,345 --in-use true --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAutomateResponseConfigStatus

parameters.help_en: A JSON array of automated response rule IDs
parameters.help_zh: 自动响应规则ID列表，json数组
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The enabling status of the rule. Valid values:

true: enabled

false: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开启状态。 取值：
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: in_use

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account that the administrator wants to access
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center for threat analysis is deployed. You must select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en: The status code of the request

Data.description_en: The return value of the request

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

false: The request failed

请求是否成功。取值：
true：成功
